summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for username login, RBAC (owner/sub-admin/basic), credit behavior, multibagger outputs, F&O dual-pane projections, custom script run, and admin quota flows on public preview URL.
action_items: Fix React list key warning in multibagger table map (App.js uses fragment without key, causing console warning during render).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js multibagger table renders two rows inside shorthand fragment `<>...</>` within `.map` without key on the fragment. React warns: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop'.
No blocking API or UI integration failures reproduced in this run; all requested functional flows passed.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary sub-admin and basic users during UI/API tests; cleaned up at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest passed 21/21 including new upgrade-flow suite. UI automation validated: owner login @shish123, no pre-population before generation, multibagger table RSI/GTT + target/profit rows, F&O dual panes (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY) with strike filter span and reports, top-4 panel population, custom script success, sub-admin quota block, and basic-user credit deduction (3->2->0) while owner/sub-admin remained EXEMPT.
rca of the issue: Only defect observed was frontend React render warning from missing key on mapped fragment in multibagger table rows. Repro: login any user -> generate multibagger -> browser console logs unique key warning from TableBody render path. Mitigation: attach key to parent fragment or return keyed wrapper element for each mapped pair.
